summary.zh: 承淡安在《针灸精华》(1951)中的立场很明确：响应“中医科学化”，放弃玄学传统，把针灸定位为“物理刺激疗法”，以科学病理诊断来确定治疗；全书用问答体、参考日本针灸书籍，不采录不科学的玄虚学说，旧病名仅附在新医病名之后。
summary.en: In Acupuncture Essence (1951) Cheng answers the call for 'scientising Chinese medicine': drop the metaphysical tradition, treat acupuncture as a physical-stimulation therapy, and fix treatment from scientific pathological diagnosis. The book is in Q&A form, draws on Japanese acupuncture books, excludes unscientific speculation, and keeps old TCM disease names only in parentheses.

takeaways.zh: 目的是“中医科学化”：放弃数千年玄学医学的传统，让祖国几千年的治疗经验“通过科学的形式”确定其实际效果，并从科学病理诊断中确定实际治疗。
takeaways.en: The aim is 'scientising' Chinese medicine: abandon the metaphysical medical tradition, let millennia of therapeutic experience be confirmed 'through scientific form', and fix the actual treatment from scientific pathological diagnosis.

takeaways.zh: 对针灸的定位：它是祖国独有发明的“物理刺激疗法”，属固有医学的一个重要部门；其价值在于应用范围广、疗效捷速而准确，除预防外主要用于对症治疗。
takeaways.en: Positioning: acupuncture-moxibustion is a 'physical stimulation therapy' uniquely invented in China, an important branch of native medicine; its worth lies in wide application and fast, accurate effect, chiefly for symptomatic treatment apart from prevention.

takeaways.zh: 改进的方向是“抛弃陈说，创造新知”：把含有玄学成分的针灸术改进为科学针灸，《针灸精华》自视为通向科学化的“津梁”，而不是终点。
takeaways.en: The direction is 'discard old doctrines, create new knowledge': turn acupuncture that carries metaphysical elements into scientific acupuncture; the book sees itself as a bridge, not a destination.

takeaways.zh: 取舍原则写在凡例里：针科、灸科的内容要“切合实际”，“不科学的玄虚学说，全不采录”。落到实处，如补泻迎随被明说“今已不讲”，补、泻改按刺激强弱与兴奋、制止来解释。
takeaways.en: The rule of selection is stated in the editorial notes: needling and moxa content must fit practice, and 'unscientific, abstruse doctrines are not adopted at all'. In practice, supplementing/draining-and-meeting/following is declared 'no longer discussed', and bu/xie are re-read as stimulation strength and excitation vs. inhibition.

takeaways.zh: 知识来源与写法：集历年心得，参考日本针灸书籍，结合多年临床；采问答体、行文力求简明，为的是让读者容易了解各科主要常识。
takeaways.en: Sources and style: his years of experience, Japanese acupuncture books, and long clinical practice, presented as questions and answers in deliberately brief prose so readers can grasp the main knowledge of each branch.

takeaways.zh: 对读者的桥梁设计：病理诊断治疗篇全部采用新医名词配合针灸治疗；为了照顾未参加过新医进修的中医同道，在新医病名之下注入中医病名。
takeaways.en: Bridge for readers: the pathology/treatment part uses new-medicine terms throughout, matched to acupuncture treatment; for TCM colleagues who have not had modern-medicine training, the traditional disease name is placed beneath each new name.

takeaways.zh: 科学化的前提是知识基础：针灸家不明人体构造与生理，一针一灸不仅无效还会致害，所以生理解剖被单独立为第一篇，且完全采用新学说编成；经穴学则从简，只记一二例，其余请参看《中国针灸学讲义》。
takeaways.en: Scientising presupposes basic knowledge: an acupuncturist ignorant of structure and physiology gets no effect and may do harm, so anatomy/physiology is placed first and compiled entirely from the new theories; points learning is kept short, with the rest deferred to his Lectures on Chinese Acupuncture.

takeaways.zh: 科学化也包括职业规范：消毒不可怠忽，不适应证及不明了的症状不随便施术，不用夸大广告以营利为目的。
takeaways.en: Scientising also covers professional conduct: never neglect sterilisation, do not treat non-indicated or unclear conditions at random, and do not use exaggerated advertising for profit.

body.zh: 《针灸精华》以1951年中国针灸学研究社出版的《针灸精华(即针灸医事常识问题第一二三辑合订本)》为底本，原在《针灸杂志》陆续发表。自序把全书放在中央号召“中医科学化”、各地设立新医进修班的背景里：中医工作者要“迎头赶上时代”，而针灸尚无这类科学问答的专著，所以他自任其事。全书六篇：生理解剖、消毒卫生、针科、灸科、经穴、病理诊断治疗。
body.en: The book is based on the 1951 combined volume of the Q&A series on acupuncture practice knowledge, first serialised in the Acupuncture Journal. The preface places it in the campaign to 'scientise Chinese medicine' and the new-medicine refresher classes: TCM workers were to 'catch up with the times', and there was no scientific Q&A monograph on acupuncture, so he undertook one. It has six parts: anatomy/physiology, sterilisation/hygiene, needling, moxibustion, points, and pathology-diagnosis-treatment.

h.en: What he keeps and what he drops

body.zh: 保留的是可用刺激、反射、诱导、神经与血液反应来说明的临床经验，如针刺的兴奋、镇静、诱导作用，灸的白细胞与免疫反应。放弃的是没有这种解释的玄虚学说；补泻迎随被列为古针之法并说明“今已不讲”，出针的旧式补泻只作为“旧式名”附在强、弱刺激法之后。旧名词并未被简单丢弃，而是被对译，见下表。
body.en: He keeps clinical experience that can be explained by stimulation, reflex, induction, and nerve and blood responses: needling's excitatory, inhibitory and inducing effects, moxa's white-cell and immune responses. He drops abstruse doctrines with no such explanation: supplement/drain-meet-follow is listed as an old technique 'no longer discussed', and old bu/xie survive only as 'old names' after the strong and weak stimulation methods. Old terms are translated rather than simply thrown away (see table).

body.zh: 《针灸精华》讲原理与常识(为什么、怎样做、何时不可做)；《针灸处方集》则按病列出处方。本模块只整理前者的基础观念；处方集与各系统治疗另有专章。
body.en: Acupuncture Essence gives principles and practice knowledge (why, how, and when not); the Prescription Collection lists prescriptions by disease. This module covers only the foundations of the former; prescriptions and system-by-system treatment are handled elsewhere.

how_to_use.zh: 学他的方法，先问三件事：这个病属于什么病理过程(诊断)？针或灸要产生兴奋、镇静还是诱导(效用)？这种效用需要多大的刺激、多深的针、多大的炷(剂量)？凡是回答不了的“玄虚”说法，他的做法是不采录，而不是硬套。读他的书时，遇到旧名词先看他如何对译。
how_to_use.en: To use his method, ask three things: what pathological process is this (diagnosis)? does the needle or moxa need to excite, inhibit or induce (effect)? and how strong a stimulus, how deep a needle, how large a cone (dose)? Where a doctrine cannot be answered in these terms, he leaves it out rather than forcing it. When reading, check first how he re-labels an old term.

caveats.zh: 书中大量使用民国时期的西医名词与译名(如偻麻质斯、黑特氏带、蛋白体疗法)，出版方为保存原貌一律未改，与今通行名称并不对应；书中引用的多是二三十年代日本学者的实验，其“科学”是当时的科学。
caveats.en: The book uses many Republican-era Western terms and transliterations (e.g. rheumatism, Head's zones, protein therapy) which the publisher deliberately left unchanged and which do not map neatly onto current terminology; the experiments it cites are mostly 1920s-30s Japanese work, so its 'science' is that of its time.
